name: Numeric Label (Read-Only Computed Display)
description: Read-only formatted numeric display, bound to a dataset field but never edited by the user — used for computed/summary values (totals, tax, net amount). An alternative to atom.number-input with disabled:true; both styles are used in the same real file, but dxnumlbl is preferred specifically for values that are ALWAYS computed (never directly enterable), while a disabled dxnumberbox is used for values that are sometimes editable depending on page mode/context.
